content: We use 300D GloVe vectors, 2-layer 150D or 300D encoders, and a 300D MLP classifier for the models, however unlike previous experiments we tune the word embeddings during training. The results on SST are listed in Table TABREF35 . Our models achieve the new state-of-the-art accuracy on SST-2 and competitive accuracy on SST-5, without utilizing parse tree information.
